arkivar.brukere.ingress: Assign roles, deactivate users and create teachers and administrators. Students register themselves.
arkivar.bunn.ovingssystem: {appnavn} is a training system. {virksomhet}, the cases and the people are fictional.
arkivar.domener.domene.hjelp: The part after @ in the email address.
arkivar.domener.ingress: Students with an email address from one of these domains can register themselves. Others need a class code.
arkivar.domener.sted.hjelp: The name the students see, for example the name of the institution.
arkivar.domener.underdomener.valg: Also approve subdomains (for example stud. before the domain)
arkivar.feil.nett: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
arkivar.feil.side: The page could not be shown.
arkivar.hjem.arkivet.tekst: The mail room, the cases and the journal have not been added yet. This is where the sample documents you will register will appear.
arkivar.hjem.drift.tekst: Under Administration you can create the first administrator and add the approved email domains.
arkivar.hjem.drift.tittel: You are logged in as operations
arkivar.hjem.ingress: {appnavn} is a training system for case and records management in {virksomhet}.
arkivar.hjem.klasser.ingen: You are not in any class.
arkivar.installasjon.bruker.ingress: Create the operations user. It is used for installation, updates and backups, and to create the first administrator.
arkivar.installasjon.database.adresse.hj: With https and without a path, for example https://ark-ivar.example.no.
arkivar.installasjon.database.ingress: You get the database details from your web host. They are stored in the file .env on the server.
arkivar.installasjon.ferdig.ingress: Keep the recovery codes safe. Each code works once when the authenticator app is not available. They will not be shown again.
arkivar.installasjon.kode.ingress: The code is in the file drift/installasjonskode.txt on the server. It shows that you have access to the files.
arkivar.installasjon.mangler: The server is missing something that is required: {liste}.
arkivar.installasjon.totp.ingress: Add this key to an authenticator app, and enter the code the app shows.
arkivar.installasjon.totp.lenke: Some apps accept the whole address instead:
arkivar.klasser.ingress: Create a class and share the code with the students. With the code they can register, and you can see who has joined.
arkivar.klasser.kodehjelp: If you make a new code, the old one stops working. Students who have already joined stay in the class.
arkivar.konto.bekreft.ingress: We have sent a code to your email address. Enter it here.
arkivar.konto.bekreft.ny_sendt: If the address has an unconfirmed account, a new code has been sent.
arkivar.konto.bekreft.sendt: The code has been sent to {epost}. Check your spam folder too.
arkivar.konto.drift.ingress: For those who install and operate the system. Students and teachers log in with their email address.
arkivar.konto.drift.totp: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
arkivar.konto.glemt.ingress: Enter your email address and we will send a code you can use to choose a new password.
arkivar.konto.glemt.sendt: If the address has an account, a code has been sent to it.
arkivar.konto.inn.ingress: Practise case and records management in {virksomhet}.
arkivar.konto.klassekode.hjelp: If your teacher has given you a code, enter it here. Then you can use any email address.
arkivar.konto.kode.hjelp: Eight characters, for example 7KQ2-M4XD. The code is valid for 30 minutes.
arkivar.konto.passordhjelp: At least {min} characters. Long passphrases are good.
arkivar.konto.registrer.ingen_steder: You need a class code from your teacher to register.
arkivar.konto.registrer.ingress: You get your own training archive for {virksomhet}.
arkivar.konto.registrer.steder: Use the address from your institution. These are approved:
arkivar.min_side.klasser.hjelp: You get the code from your teacher.
arkivar.min_side.passord.byttet: The password has been changed. You have been logged out elsewhere.
